Title: Customer signs in
Steps: 1. Open the shop. 2. Choose Sign in. 3. Enter the provisioned shopper email and its environment-configured password. 4. Submit.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and Sign out is displayed.

Title: Administrator signs in
Steps: 1. Open the shop. 2. Sign in with the provisioned administrator account.
Expected Result: The account is signed in and Manage products is available.

Title: Email matching ignores case
Steps: 1. Open Sign in. 2. Enter SHOPPER@EXAMPLE.COM and the correct shopper password. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The shopper is signed in.

Title: Spaces around login email
Steps: 1. Enter the shopper email with spaces before and after it. 2. Enter the correct password. 3. Submit the sign-in request manually if the browser normalizes the email.
Expected Result: The trimmed address matches the shopper account.

Title: Incorrect shopper password
Steps: 1. Open Sign in. 2. Enter the shopper email and an incorrect password of valid length. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Email or password is incorrect is displayed and the user remains signed out.

Title: Unrecognized account
Steps: 1. Enter an email that has not been provisioned. 2. Enter a password of valid length. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The same incorrect-email-or-password message is shown as for a wrong password.

Title: Sign in without email
Steps: 1. Open Sign in. 2. Leave Email empty. 3. Enter a password and submit.
Expected Result: The form does not complete sign-in and indicates that Email is required.

Title: Sign in without password
Steps: 1. Enter the shopper email. 2. Leave Password empty. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The form does not complete sign-in and indicates that Password is required.

Title: Invalid email shape
Steps: 1. Enter shopper.example.com as Email. 2. Enter a password. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Sign-in is prevented because the email format is invalid.

Title: Short password request
Steps: 1. Using the browser request editor send a sign-in request with a valid email and a 9-character password.
Expected Result: The request is rejected with a password-length message.

Title: Ten-character account password
Steps: 1. Have an account provisioned with a 10-character password. 2. Sign in with that account.
Expected Result: The account can sign in.

Title: Long email in login
Steps: 1. Try a very long email in the sign-in form and submit it.

Title: Password with surrounding spaces
Steps: 1. Provision an account whose password includes leading and trailing spaces. 2. Sign in using the complete password.
Expected Result: Sign-in succeeds when the spaces are preserved as part of the password.

Title: Password longer than 128 characters
Steps: 1. Manually submit a sign-in request with a 129-character password and a valid email.
Expected Result: The request is rejected with the password-length message.

Title: Sign in as shopper
Steps: 1. Go to the shop. 2. Enter the shopper credentials in Sign in. 3. Continue.
Expected Result: The shopper is logged in and can see Sign out.

Title: No self-service registration
Steps: 1. Open the sign-in dialog. 2. Review the available account actions.
Expected Result: The dialog asks for a provisioned account and offers no registration or password-recovery flow.

Title: Twenty login attempts
Steps: 1. Start with a fresh sign-in rate-limit window for one network address. 2. Submit 20 validly formed sign-in attempts.
Expected Result: The twentieth attempt is processed rather than rate-limited.

Title: Twenty-first login attempt
Steps: 1. Make 20 sign-in attempts from one network address within 15 minutes. 2. Submit another attempt.
Expected Result: The additional attempt is rejected with a try-again-later message.

Title: Successful attempts count toward throttling
Steps: 1. From one address sign in successfully 20 times within the same window. 2. Attempt another sign-in.
Expected Result: The next request is rate-limited even though earlier credentials were correct.

Title: Retry after the login wait
Steps: 1. Trigger the sign-in wait. 2. Leave it for a while. 3. Try again.

Title: Sign-in after window expires
Steps: 1. Reach the attempt limit. 2. Wait until the 15-minute window has expired. 3. Sign in with correct credentials.
Expected Result: Sign-in is processed again.

Title: Login retry guidance
Steps: 1. Trigger repeated-login blocking. 2. Inspect the response in browser developer tools.
Expected Result: The response asks the user to try later and includes a positive Retry-After value.

Title: Customer signs out
Steps: 1. Sign in as a shopper. 2. Choose Sign out.
Expected Result: The storefront displays Sign in instead of Sign out.

Title: Signed-out session cannot reopen bag
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Sign out. 3. Select Bag.
Expected Result: The sign-in dialog opens rather than the private bag.

Title: Sign-in survives page refresh
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Refresh the page before the eight-hour expiry.
Expected Result: The shopper remains signed in.

Title: Session expires after eight hours
Steps: 1. Sign in on a controlled environment. 2. Allow the session to exceed eight hours. 3. Refresh and select Bag.
Expected Result: The user must sign in again.

Title: Session before expiry
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Keep the session below eight hours. 3. Open the bag.
Expected Result: The signed-in shopper can still open the bag.

Title: Restart ends sign-in session
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Restart the shop service. 3. Refresh the browser.
Expected Result: The browser no longer has valid signed-in access.

Title: Sign out from a second tab
Steps: 1. Open the signed-in shop in two tabs. 2. Sign out in one. 3. Do something with the bag in the other.

Title: Revoked session token
Steps: 1. Sign in and retain the session cookie for a manual request. 2. Sign out. 3. Request the bag with the retained cookie.
Expected Result: The old session is not accepted.

Title: Guest selects bag
Steps: 1. Open a fresh signed-out browser. 2. Choose Bag.
Expected Result: The shop prompts the visitor to sign in.

Title: Guest selects Add to bag
Steps: 1. Browse while signed out. 2. Choose Add to bag on an in-stock product.
Expected Result: The sign-in dialog opens and no anonymous bag addition is made.

Title: Guest requests private bag directly
Steps: 1. Use developer tools to request GET /api/cart without a session.
Expected Result: The request returns a sign-in-required response.

Title: Guest submits bag update
Steps: 1. Manually send a correctly formed PUT /api/cart request without a session.
Expected Result: The shop refuses the update and requests sign-in.

Title: Guest requests checkout totals
Steps: 1. Manually send POST /api/checkout/quote with valid request headers but no session.
Expected Result: The shop refuses the quote and requests sign-in.

Title: Guest submits order
Steps: 1. Prepare an otherwise valid order request. 2. Submit it without a session.
Expected Result: No order is placed and sign-in is required.

Title: Separate customer bags
Steps: 1. Provision two customer accounts. 2. Add a tote as customer A. 3. Sign out and sign in as customer B. 4. Open Bag.
Expected Result: Customer B does not see customer A's tote.

Title: Supplied customer ID does not select another bag
Steps: 1. Sign in as customer B. 2. Manually request the bag while supplying customer A's ID as an extra query value.
Expected Result: The returned bag belongs to the signed-in customer B.

Title: Visitor sees initial collection
Steps: 1. Open a fresh shop using the initial catalog. 2. Scroll to the collection.
Expected Result: Six product cards are displayed without requiring sign-in.

Title: Product name and description
Steps: 1. Open the initial catalog. 2. Look at the Everyday canvas tote card.
Expected Result: The card shows the product name and its catalog description.

Title: Product price formatting
Steps: 1. Open the initial collection. 2. Review the tote and mug prices.
Expected Result: The tote shows $28.00 and the mug shows $24.00.

Title: Product category label
Steps: 1. Locate the canvas tote in the collection.
Expected Result: The card displays the Carry category.

Title: Product symbol and background
Steps: 1. Browse the initial collection. 2. Compare the product cards.
Expected Result: Products display their saved symbols and background colors.

Title: Collection on a phone
Steps: 1. Open the shop on a phone. 2. Look through the cards.
Expected Result: Product details and Add to bag controls can be viewed.

Title: Zero-stock item remains listed
Steps: 1. Set a product's stock to zero using an administrator account. 2. Browse the collection as a visitor.
Expected Result: The product is still visible and is labelled Out of stock.

Title: Out-of-stock card appearance
Steps: 1. Find a sold-out item. 2. Check the button.

Title: In-stock product can be selected
Steps: 1. Browse a product with positive stock. 2. Check its card after the page has loaded.
Expected Result: Add to bag is available.

Title: Updated product details appear
Steps: 1. Change a product name and description as an administrator. 2. Refresh the public collection.
Expected Result: The public card displays the saved name and description.

Title: Search for mug
Steps: 1. Open the collection. 2. Enter mug in Search products.
Expected Result: The Slow morning mug is the only matching initial product.

Title: Search ignores case
Steps: 1. Enter MUG in Search products.
Expected Result: The Slow morning mug is returned.

Title: Search by description text
Steps: 1. Search the initial collection for heavyweight.
Expected Result: The Everyday canvas tote is returned.

Title: Search by category text
Steps: 1. With All goods selected search for Workspace.
Expected Result: The notebook and desk light are returned.

Title: Spaces around search text
Steps: 1. Enter spaces followed by mug and more spaces.
Expected Result: The results match a search for mug.

Title: Blank search
Steps: 1. Select All goods. 2. Clear Search products.
Expected Result: The whole current catalog is displayed.

Title: Search punctuation is literal
Steps: 1. Search the initial catalog for .* using the search field.
Expected Result: The text is treated literally rather than matching every product.

Title: One-hundred-character search
Steps: 1. Submit a product search containing exactly 100 ordinary letters.
Expected Result: The search is accepted and returns matching products or an empty result.

Title: Search while typing
Steps: 1. Type a product name normally and watch the collection.
Expected Result: The collection updates to match the entered text.

Title: Search longer than 100 characters
Steps: 1. Manually request /api/products with q containing 101 letters.
Expected Result: The search request is rejected with a length message.

Title: Change search quickly
Steps: 1. Type a bit in the search box. 2. Change it quickly.

Title: Find the morning mug
Steps: 1. Go to the shop collection. 2. Search for mug.
Expected Result: Only the Slow morning mug is shown in the initial catalog.

Title: Home category
Steps: 1. Open the initial collection. 2. Select Home.
Expected Result: The mug and carafe and throw are displayed.

Title: Carry category
Steps: 1. Select Carry in the initial collection.
Expected Result: Only the Everyday canvas tote is displayed.

Title: Workspace category
Steps: 1. Select Workspace in the initial collection.
Expected Result: The notebook and desk light are displayed.

Title: Return to All goods
Steps: 1. Select Home. 2. Select All goods.
Expected Result: The category restriction is removed.

Title: Search combined with category
Steps: 1. Select Home. 2. Search for mug.
Expected Result: Only the matching Home product is displayed.

Title: No matches message
Steps: 1. Select Carry. 2. Search for mug in the initial catalog.
Expected Result: The shop shows No good things found and a Clear filters action.

Title: Clear the collection filters
Steps: 1. Put some filters on. 2. Get no products. 3. Clear filters.
Expected Result: The search and category are reset and products are displayed again.

Title: Category matching is exact
Steps: 1. Manually request products using category=home instead of Home.
Expected Result: Products in Home are not matched by the differently cased category.

Title: Category filter length
Steps: 1. Manually request products with a category filter of 41 letters.
Expected Result: The request is rejected for exceeding the category-filter length.

Title: Custom category storefront choices
Steps: 1. Create a product in category Garden. 2. Refresh the collection. 3. Review category buttons and All goods.
Expected Result: The product appears under All goods and no Garden button is added automatically.

Title: Add first tote
Steps: 1. Sign in with an empty shopper bag. 2. Choose Add to bag for Everyday canvas tote.
Expected Result: The bag count becomes 1 and a bag-updated message appears.

Title: Open bag after adding
Steps: 1. Sign in and add one tote to an empty bag. 2. Choose Bag.
Expected Result: The bag lists one tote at $28.00.

Title: Add another product
Steps: 1. Add a tote. 2. Add a mug. 3. Open Bag.
Expected Result: Both products appear and the bag count is 2.

Title: Change bag quantities
Steps: 1. Put a couple of items in the bag. 2. Change the quantities a bit.

Title: Add the same product again
Steps: 1. Add one tote. 2. Add the tote again. 3. Open Bag.
Expected Result: One tote line is shown with quantity 2.

Title: Bag survives sign-out
Steps: 1. Add a mug. 2. Sign out. 3. Sign back in using the same account. 4. Open Bag.
Expected Result: The mug remains in that account's bag.

Title: Bag uses new catalog price
Steps: 1. Add a tote. 2. Have an administrator change its price. 3. Refresh the shopper page and open Bag.
Expected Result: The tote line and subtotal use the current price.

Title: Continue shopping
Steps: 1. Open a bag containing a product. 2. Choose Continue shopping.
Expected Result: The collection is displayed.

Title: Put a tote into an empty bag
Steps: 1. Log in as the shopper with an empty bag. 2. Add the canvas tote.
Expected Result: The header shows one item in the bag.

Title: Bag quantity contributes to header count
Steps: 1. Set tote quantity to 2 and mug quantity to 1. 2. Review the bag button.
Expected Result: The bag count is 3.

Title: Quantity of one
Steps: 1. Sign in with an empty bag. 2. Add one available tote.
Expected Result: The product is saved with quantity 1.

Title: Quantity of ten
Steps: 1. Use a product with at least 10 units of stock. 2. Set bag quantity to 10.
Expected Result: The bag accepts quantity 10.

Title: Quantity above ten
Steps: 1. Manually submit an authenticated bag update with quantity 11 and sufficient product stock.
Expected Result: The change is rejected and the previous bag quantity is retained.

Title: Fractional bag quantity
Steps: 1. Manually submit quantity 1.5 for an available product.
Expected Result: The request is rejected because quantity must be a whole number.

Title: Negative bag quantity
Steps: 1. Manually submit quantity -1 for a bag product.
Expected Result: The update is rejected.

Title: Thirty different products
Steps: 1. Prepare at least 30 available products. 2. Add one of each of 30 different products to one customer's bag.
Expected Result: All 30 different products can be held in the bag.

Title: Thirty-first different product
Steps: 1. Fill a bag with 30 different products. 2. Add another different product.
Expected Result: The new line is rejected and the existing 30 lines remain.

Title: Update existing line in full bag
Steps: 1. Fill a bag with 30 different products. 2. Increase one existing line from 1 to 2 with sufficient stock.
Expected Result: The existing line is updated without adding a thirty-first line.

Title: Quantity equals current stock
Steps: 1. Use a product with stock 3. 2. Set its bag quantity to 3.
Expected Result: The bag accepts the requested quantity.

Title: Quantity exceeds current stock
Steps: 1. Use a product with stock 3. 2. Manually request bag quantity 4.
Expected Result: The update is rejected with an insufficient-stock message.

Title: Remove a bag line
Steps: 1. Add a product and open Bag. 2. Choose Remove on its line.
Expected Result: The line disappears and the bag count is recalculated.

Title: Zero quantity removes product
Steps: 1. Put a tote in the bag. 2. Manually submit an authenticated quantity update of zero.
Expected Result: The tote is removed from the bag.

Title: Remove the last bag item
Steps: 1. Open a bag with one line. 2. Remove it.
Expected Result: The empty-bag view is displayed.

Title: Adding does not reserve stock
Steps: 1. Record a product's stock in management. 2. Add it to a customer bag. 3. Review stock in management again.
Expected Result: Stock has not decreased merely because the item is in the bag.

Title: Two bags can contain the same stock
Steps: 1. Use a product with stock 1. 2. Add it to customer A's bag. 3. Add it to customer B's bag.
Expected Result: Both bags can contain the product before either customer completes checkout.

Title: Remove after stock is reduced
Steps: 1. Put a product in a bag. 2. Reduce its catalog stock to zero. 3. Remove it from the bag.
Expected Result: The item can be removed despite having no current stock.

Title: Deleted product in bag
Steps: 1. Add a product to a shopper bag. 2. Delete that product as an administrator. 3. Refresh and reopen the shopper bag.
Expected Result: The line is displayed as Unavailable product.

Title: Remove deleted bag product
Steps: 1. Open a bag containing a deleted product. 2. Choose Remove on that line.
Expected Result: The unavailable line is removed.

Title: Checkout with deleted product
Steps: 1. Leave a deleted product in the shopper bag. 2. Choose Continue to checkout.
Expected Result: Checkout is refused and the shopper is asked to update the bag.

Title: Bag after stock changes
Steps: 1. Have some items in the bag. 2. Change stock in management. 3. Try checkout.

Title: Mixed available and unavailable bag
Steps: 1. Add two products. 2. Delete one as an administrator. 3. Refresh and open Bag.
Expected Result: The remaining product details stay visible and the deleted line is marked unavailable.

Title: Proceed after removing unavailable line
Steps: 1. Open a bag with an available item and a deleted item. 2. Remove the deleted line. 3. Continue to checkout.
Expected Result: Checkout totals can be obtained for the available item.

Title: Apply WELCOME10
Steps: 1. Add one $28.00 tote. 2. Open Bag. 3. Enter WELCOME10 and choose Apply.
Expected Result: The discount is $2.80.

Title: Lowercase discount code
Steps: 1. Add an available product. 2. Apply welcome10.
Expected Result: The 10% discount is applied.

Title: Mixed-case discount code
Steps: 1. Apply WeLcOmE10 to a nonempty bag.
Expected Result: The code is accepted.

Title: Spaces around discount code
Steps: 1. Enter WELCOME10 with spaces before and after it. 2. Apply it.
Expected Result: The trimmed code is accepted.

Title: Blank discount code
Steps: 1. Open a nonempty bag. 2. Leave the code blank and choose Apply.
Expected Result: Totals are returned with zero discount.

Title: Unsupported discount code
Steps: 1. Open a nonempty bag. 2. Apply SAVE20.
Expected Result: The shop reports that the discount code is not valid.

Title: Discount rounded to nearest cent
Steps: 1. Prepare a bag with merchandise subtotal $10.05. 2. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: The discount is $1.01.

Title: Discount on two products
Steps: 1. Add a tote and a mug. 2. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: The $52.00 subtotal receives a $5.20 discount.

Title: Code after previous order
Steps: 1. Complete an order using WELCOME10. 2. Start another nonempty bag for the same shopper. 3. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: The code can be applied again.

Title: Change the discount entry
Steps: 1. Apply the welcome code. 2. Change it. 3. Apply again.

Title: Code exceeds thirty characters
Steps: 1. Manually request a checkout quote with a discount code of 31 characters.
Expected Result: The request is rejected for the code length.

Title: Whitespace-only discount code
Steps: 1. Put spaces in the discount field. 2. Apply it to a nonempty bag.
Expected Result: The code is treated as blank and the discount is zero.

Title: Shipping below threshold
Steps: 1. Add one $28.00 tote. 2. Review totals with no discount.
Expected Result: Shipping is $5.00 and total is $33.00.

Title: Shipping exactly at threshold
Steps: 1. Prepare a bag with subtotal $75.00 and no discount. 2. Obtain checkout totals.
Expected Result: Shipping is free and total is $75.00.

Title: Shipping just below threshold
Steps: 1. Prepare a bag with subtotal $74.99 and no discount. 2. Obtain checkout totals.
Expected Result: Shipping is $5.00 and total is $79.99.

Title: Shipping above threshold
Steps: 1. Prepare a bag with subtotal $75.01 and no discount. 2. Obtain checkout totals.
Expected Result: Shipping is free.

Title: Discount changes shipping eligibility
Steps: 1. Prepare an $80.00 merchandise subtotal. 2. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: Discount is $8.00 and shipping is $5.00 because the discounted subtotal is $72.00.

Title: Discounted subtotal at threshold
Steps: 1. Prepare an $83.33 merchandise subtotal. 2. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: Discount rounds to $8.33 and the $75.00 remainder qualifies for free shipping.

Title: No tax added
Steps: 1. Open checkout for a nonempty bag. 2. Review the total breakdown.
Expected Result: The total consists of subtotal minus discount plus shipping with no separate tax charge.

Title: Review dollar display
Steps: 1. Open a bag and check the amounts on screen.
Expected Result: Amounts use dollar signs and two decimal places.

Title: Totals for two totes and one mug
Steps: 1. Add two $28.00 totes and one $24.00 mug. 2. Review totals without a discount.
Expected Result: Subtotal and total are $80.00 with free shipping.

Title: Discount with paid shipping
Steps: 1. Add one $24.00 mug. 2. Apply WELCOME10.
Expected Result: Discount is $2.40 and shipping is $5.00 and total is $26.60.

Title: Quote for empty bag
Steps: 1. Sign in with an empty bag. 2. Manually submit a valid checkout quote request.
Expected Result: The quote is refused because the bag is empty.

Title: Place order from empty bag
Steps: 1. Sign in with an empty bag. 2. Manually submit an otherwise valid order request with a new checkout reference.
Expected Result: The shop refuses to place an order for an empty bag.

Title: Obtain current checkout quote
Steps: 1. Add an available product. 2. Open Bag. 3. Choose Continue to checkout.
Expected Result: The delivery page displays totals calculated by the shop.

Title: Ignore supplied total
Steps: 1. Prepare a valid order for an available bag. 2. In a manual request add a total of 1 cent. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The order records the shop-calculated total rather than the supplied total.

Title: Price changes before checkout
Steps: 1. Add a product. 2. Change its price using an administrator account. 3. Refresh the shopper bag and continue to checkout.
Expected Result: The checkout quote uses the updated catalog price.

Title: Price changes after quote
Steps: 1. Obtain a checkout quote. 2. Change a bag product's price as an administrator. 3. Submit the order.
Expected Result: The saved order uses the current shop-calculated price.

Title: Stock changes after quote
Steps: 1. Quote a bag with quantity 2. 2. Reduce the product's stock to 1. 3. Submit the order.
Expected Result: The order is refused because current stock is insufficient.

Title: Customer-submitted discount amount
Steps: 1. Prepare a valid order with WELCOME10. 2. Add a large discount amount in the manual request. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The shop calculates the supported discount itself.

Title: Complete delivery form
Steps: 1. Add an available product and continue to checkout. 2. Enter a valid full name and email and address and city and postal code. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: The delivery details are accepted and a demo order can be placed.

Title: Missing full name
Steps: 1. Open checkout. 2. Fill the other delivery fields. 3. Leave Full name blank and submit.
Expected Result: The form does not complete and identifies the required name field.

Title: Full name minimum
Steps: 1. Submit otherwise valid delivery details using a two-character full name.
Expected Result: The name is accepted.

Title: Full name too short
Steps: 1. Manually submit otherwise valid delivery details using a one-character name.
Expected Result: The order is rejected with a full-name length message.

Title: Very long full name
Steps: 1. Try a long name in checkout and submit the form.

Title: Address minimum length
Steps: 1. Submit otherwise valid delivery details with a five-character street address.
Expected Result: The address is accepted.

Title: Address too short
Steps: 1. Manually submit a four-character address with the remaining delivery fields valid.
Expected Result: The order is rejected with an address-length message.

Title: Return to bag from delivery
Steps: 1. Open checkout with a product in the bag. 2. Choose Back to bag.
Expected Result: The bag is shown with the product still present.

Title: City maximum length
Steps: 1. Submit otherwise valid delivery details with an 80-character city.
Expected Result: The city is accepted.

Title: City beyond maximum
Steps: 1. Manually submit otherwise valid delivery details with an 81-character city.
Expected Result: The order is rejected with a city-length message.

Title: Postal code minimum
Steps: 1. Submit otherwise valid delivery details with a two-character postal code.
Expected Result: The postal code is accepted.

Title: Postal code beyond maximum
Steps: 1. Manually submit otherwise valid delivery details with a 21-character postal code.
Expected Result: The order is rejected with a postal-code length message.

Title: Postal code without national formatting
Steps: 1. Enter a 2-20 character postal code that has no control characters but does not match a national postal pattern. 2. Complete the other fields and submit.
Expected Result: The postal code is not rejected on country-format grounds.

Title: Invalid delivery email
Steps: 1. Fill delivery details with an email lacking @. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: The invalid email prevents order placement.

Title: Trim surrounding address spaces
Steps: 1. Manually submit valid delivery text with surrounding spaces in the name and address and city and postal code. 2. Inspect the saved order in the QA store.
Expected Result: Those delivery values are stored without surrounding spaces.

Title: Address above two hundred characters
Steps: 1. Manually submit an otherwise valid order using a 201-character street address.
Expected Result: The address is rejected and no order is placed.

Title: Create an order record
Steps: 1. Use a fresh QA bag with an available tote. 2. Complete checkout. 3. Inspect the QA store's order record.
Expected Result: The record has an order reference and creation time and shopper and delivery details.

Title: Purchased stock decreases
Steps: 1. Record a product's stock. 2. Order two units. 3. Review its stock in management.
Expected Result: Stock has decreased by two.

Title: Bag clears after successful order
Steps: 1. Complete an order from a nonempty bag. 2. Open Bag again.
Expected Result: The purchased bag is empty.

Title: Order keeps product snapshot
Steps: 1. Order a product. 2. Change its catalog name and price. 3. Inspect the saved QA order.
Expected Result: The completed order retains the product name and price recorded at purchase.

Title: Order records discounted amounts
Steps: 1. Place an order with WELCOME10. 2. Review the saved QA order.
Expected Result: The order records subtotal and discount code and discount amount and shipping and total.

Title: Order with multiple products
Steps: 1. Add a tote and a mug. 2. Place a valid order. 3. Review the order and stock.
Expected Result: Both lines are recorded and each product's stock decreases by its ordered quantity.

Title: Failed save leaves no partial order
Steps: 1. In an isolated QA instance make the store destination unwritable. 2. Attempt valid checkout. 3. Restore write access and inspect the in-memory bag and stock and saved orders.
Expected Result: No partial order or stock deduction or bag clearing is retained.

Title: Recorded delivery details
Steps: 1. Place an order using recognizable delivery details. 2. Review the saved QA order.
Expected Result: The order contains the submitted validated delivery name and email and address and city and postal code.

Title: Demo notice before ordering
Steps: 1. Open the delivery page. 2. Read the checkout notice.
Expected Result: The page states that no payment is collected and no goods will be shipped.

Title: Confirmation after order
Steps: 1. Complete checkout using valid details and an available bag.
Expected Result: The confirmation says the demo order was placed and that no payment was collected.

Title: Abbreviated order reference
Steps: 1. Place a demo order. 2. Compare the confirmation reference with the saved QA order ID.
Expected Result: The confirmation shows the first eight characters of the order ID.

Title: Confirmation display on mobile
Steps: 1. Place a demo order using a phone-sized browser. 2. Look at the confirmation.
Expected Result: The order reference and total can be read.

Title: Confirmation amount
Steps: 1. Place an order for a known quoted amount. 2. Read the confirmation total.
Expected Result: The confirmation total matches the shop-calculated order total.

Title: Return from confirmation
Steps: 1. Complete an order. 2. Choose Back to the good things.
Expected Result: The collection is displayed.

Title: Management visible to administrator
Steps: 1. Sign in as an administrator. 2. Review the main navigation.
Expected Result: Manage products is available.

Title: Management absent for customer
Steps: 1. Sign in as a customer. 2. Review the main navigation.
Expected Result: Manage products is not displayed.

Title: Guest cannot create a product
Steps: 1. Manually submit a valid product creation request without a session using otherwise valid headers.
Expected Result: The request is refused and no product is created.

Title: Customer cannot create a product
Steps: 1. Sign in as a customer. 2. Manually submit a valid product creation request.
Expected Result: Administrator access is required and no product is created.

Title: Customer opens management
Steps: 1. Try to get into product management while signed in as a shopper.

Title: Customer cannot edit a product
Steps: 1. Sign in as a customer. 2. Manually submit a valid update to an existing product.
Expected Result: The update is refused for lack of administrator access.

Title: Management layout
Steps: 1. Sign in as admin. 2. Open Manage products. 3. Look over the page.
Expected Result: The product list and New product action are visible.

Title: Customer cannot delete a product
Steps: 1. Sign in as a customer. 2. Manually request deletion of an existing product.
Expected Result: The deletion is refused and the product remains.

Title: Create a complete product
Steps: 1. Sign in as administrator. 2. Open New product. 3. Complete all fields with valid values and save.
Expected Result: The product is saved and appears in the management list.

Title: Edit product description
Steps: 1. Open an existing product for editing. 2. Change its description to valid text and save.
Expected Result: The new description is saved and displayed after refresh.

Title: Product name minimum
Steps: 1. Create a valid product using a two-character name.
Expected Result: The product is accepted.

Title: Product name above maximum
Steps: 1. Manually submit valid product data except for a 101-character name.
Expected Result: The product is rejected with a name-length message.

Title: Description below minimum
Steps: 1. Manually submit otherwise valid product data with a four-character description.
Expected Result: The product is rejected.

Title: Description at maximum
Steps: 1. Save an otherwise valid product with a 500-character description.
Expected Result: The description is accepted.

Title: Category below minimum
Steps: 1. Manually submit valid product data with a one-character category.
Expected Result: The product is rejected with a category-length message.

Title: Custom category at forty characters
Steps: 1. Save an otherwise valid product with a 40-character category name.
Expected Result: The category is accepted and saved.

Title: Product symbol length
Steps: 1. Manually save valid product data with a nine-character ASCII symbol value.
Expected Result: The product is rejected because the symbol exceeds eight characters.

Title: Change product color
Steps: 1. Pick another color in the product form and save.

Title: Cancel product editing
Steps: 1. Open a product. 2. Change a field without saving. 3. Choose Cancel.
Expected Result: The edit form closes without saving the change.

Title: Reject invalid color value
Steps: 1. Manually submit otherwise valid product data with color set to blue.
Expected Result: The request is rejected because a six-digit hex color is required.

Title: Lowest product price
Steps: 1. Create a valid product with price $0.01.
Expected Result: The product is saved with a one-cent price.

Title: Zero product price
Steps: 1. Manually submit valid product data with price 0 cents.
Expected Result: The product is rejected.

Title: Highest product price
Steps: 1. Save a valid product with price $10000.00.
Expected Result: The price is accepted.

Title: Price above maximum
Steps: 1. Manually submit a price of 1000001 cents with other fields valid.
Expected Result: The request is rejected for exceeding the price limit.

Title: Fractional cent price
Steps: 1. Manually submit a price value of 100.5 cents with other fields valid.
Expected Result: The price is rejected because whole cents are required.

Title: Zero product stock
Steps: 1. Save a valid product with stock 0.
Expected Result: The product is saved as out of stock.

Title: Stock of ten thousand
Steps: 1. Save a valid product with stock 10000.
Expected Result: The stock value is accepted.

Title: Stock display after edit
Steps: 1. Change product stock and save. 2. Refresh management.
Expected Result: The saved stock is displayed.

Title: Catalog creation at capacity
Steps: 1. Prepare a catalog of 500 products. 2. Attempt to create one more valid product.
Expected Result: Creation is refused and the catalog remains at 500 products.

Title: Edit catalog at capacity
Steps: 1. Prepare a catalog of 500 products. 2. Edit an existing product using valid values.
Expected Result: The existing product can still be updated.

Title: Confirm product deletion
Steps: 1. Sign in as administrator. 2. Choose Delete on a product. 3. Confirm the prompt.
Expected Result: The product is deleted from management and public browsing.

Title: Cancel product deletion
Steps: 1. Choose Delete on a product. 2. Cancel the confirmation prompt.
Expected Result: The product remains unchanged.

Title: Delete product already ordered
Steps: 1. Place an order for a product. 2. Delete the catalog product. 3. Look at the saved order.

Title: Edit a deleted product
Steps: 1. Retain the ID of a deleted product. 2. As administrator manually submit a valid edit request for that ID.
Expected Result: The shop returns Product not found.

Title: Malformed JSON request
Steps: 1. Use a manual request tool to submit syntactically invalid JSON to a shop API write endpoint.
Expected Result: The shop returns an invalid-JSON error rather than applying a change.

Title: Request larger than sixteen KiB
Steps: 1. Manually submit an application/json body larger than 16 KiB to a shop API write endpoint.
Expected Result: The shop rejects the request as too large.

Title: Dismiss a page message
Steps: 1. Trigger a message in the shop. 2. Use its dismiss control.
Expected Result: The selected message disappears.

Title: Cross-site write request
Steps: 1. In a manual request set an Origin from another website. 2. Include the shop request header and JSON content type. 3. Submit a bag update with a valid session.
Expected Result: The write is refused because the origin does not match the shop.
